title: GAVEL: Agent Meets Checklist for Evaluating LLMs on Long-Context Legal Summarization
reasoning: The paper is focused on legal summarization and introduces an evaluation framework (GAVEL-REF) and an autonomous agent scaffold (GAVEL-AGENT). Its evaluation metrics are based on a legal checklist (e.g., filing dates, parties, court rulings) and writing style similarity; it does not evaluate or benchmark components related to religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
